saints.name: St. Marcellus I
saints.title: Pope and Martyr
saints.shortBlurb: The pope who rebuilt the Roman Church after the great persecution and was exiled for his firmness with the lapsed…
biography: Elected to the Roman see about 308, after a long vacancy caused by the persecution of Diocletian, Marcellus set himself to reorganize the shattered Church, dividing Rome into districts under its priests. He insisted that Christians who had denied the faith under torture do public penance before returning to communion.
The disputes this stirred, seized upon by his enemies, led the emperor Maxentius to banish him from the city, and he died in exile in 309, honored ever after as a martyr for the Church's discipline.
saints.knownFor: Restoring order to the Church of Rome after persecution.
